features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.desc: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 for each Sorcerer level; while you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.desc: Once when you cast a spell that deals damage of your draconic type, you add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll; for 1 Sorcery Point, you gain Resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you sprout wings and gain a Fly Speed equal to twice your Speed.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.desc: As an action and for 5 Sorcery Points, you create a 60-foot aura of awe or fear (Wisdom saving throw).
